title: Absenteeism in Nursing: A Longitudinal Study

sentences.en: Absence from work is a costly and disruptive problem for any organisation.
sentences.zh: 任何组织都面临一个昂贵和破坏性的缺勤问题。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The cost of absenteeism in Australia has been put at 1.8 million hours per day or $1400 million annually.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚的缺勤费用定为每天180万小时,每年1.4亿美元。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The study reported here was conducted in the Prince William Hospital in Brisbane, Australia, where, prior to this time, few active steps had been taken to measure, understand or manage the occurrence of absenteeism.
sentences.zh: 本文所报告的研究是在澳大利亚布里斯班威廉王子医院进行的,在此之前,在医院里几乎没有采取积极的措施来衡量、了解或管理缺勤事件。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Nursing Absenteeism A prevalent attitude amongst many nurses in the group selected for study was that there was no reward or recognition for not utilising the paid sick leave entitlement allowed them in their employment conditions.
sentences.zh: 选择研究的群体中许多护士的普遍态度是,没有奖励或承认不使用带薪病假,使他们在就业条件下享受带薪病假待遇。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Therefore, they believed they may as well take the days off — sick or otherwise.
sentences.zh: 因此,他们认为,他们最好请病假,不管生病与否。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Similar attitudes have been noted by James (1989), who noted that sick leave is seen by many workers as a right, like annual holiday leave.
sentences.zh: James(1989年)也指出了类似的态度,他指出,许多工人将病假视为权利,如年假。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Miller and Norton (1986), in their survey of 865 nursing personnel, found that 73 per cent felt they should be rewarded for not taking sick leave, because some employees always used their sick leave.
sentences.zh: Miller和Norton(1986年)在对865名护理人员进行的调查中发现,73%的人认为,他们不应休病假,因此应当得到奖励,因为有些雇员总是休病假。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Further, 67 per cent of nurses felt that administration was not sympathetic to the problems shift work causes to employees’ personal and social lives.
sentences.zh: 此外,67%的护士认为,行政部门不同情将工作原因转移到雇员个人和社会生活的问题。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

words.def: 行政行政行政行政行政

sentences.en: Only 53 per cent of the respondents felt that every effort was made to schedule staff fairly.
sentences.zh: 只有53%的答复者认为,已尽一切努力公平地安排工作人员。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: In another longitudinal study of nurses working in two Canadian hospitals, Hackett, Bycio and Guion (1989) examined the reasons why nurses took absence from work.
sentences.zh: 在对在加拿大Hackett、Bycio和Guion两家医院工作的护士进行的另一项纵向研究(1989年)中,检查了护士缺勤的原因。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The most frequent reason stated for absence was minor illness to self.
sentences.zh: 经常提出的缺勤理由是自己患有轻微疾病。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Other causes, in decreasing order of frequency, were illness in family, family social function, work to do at home and bereavement.
sentences.zh: 其他原因,按频率的下降顺序排列,是家庭疾病、家庭社会功能、在家工作以及丧葬。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Method In an attempt to reduce the level of absenteeism amongst the 250 Registered and Enrolled Nurses in the present study, the Prince William management introduced three different, yet potentially complementary, strategies over 18 months.
sentences.zh: 为了减少本研究报告中250名注册和注册护士缺勤率,威廉王子管理阶层在18个月中提出了三种不同但可能互补的战略。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Strategy 1: Non-financial (material) incentives Within the established wage and salary system it was not possible to use hospital funds to support this strategy.
sentences.zh: 战略1:非财政(物质)奖励措施在既定的工资和薪金制度内,不可能利用医院资金支持这项战略。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: However, it was possible to secure incentives from local businesses, including free passes to entertainment parks, theatres, restaurants, etc.
sentences.zh: 然而,可以确保当地企业给予奖励,包括免费出入娱乐公园、剧院、餐馆等。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: At the end of each roster period, the ward with the lowest absence rate would win the prize.
sentences.zh: 在每个名册期结束时,缺勤率最低的病房将赢得奖项。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Strategy 2: Flexible fair roistering Where possible staff were given the opportunity to determine their working schedule within the limits of clinical needs.
sentences.zh: 战略2:灵活、公平、公平的名册,尽可能让工作人员有机会在临床需要的范围内确定工作时间表。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Strategy 3: Individual absenteeism and counselling Each month, managers would analyse the pattern of absence of staff with excessive sick leave (greater than ten days per year for full time employees).
sentences.zh: 战略3:个人缺勤和咨询,管理人员每月分析休病假过多的工作人员缺勤情况(全时雇员每年超过10天)。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Characteristic patterns of potential ‘voluntary absenteeism’ such as absence before and after days off, excessive weekend and night duty absence and multiple single days off were communicated to all ward nurses and then, as necessary, followed up by action.
sentences.zh: 向所有病房护士通报了可能 " 自愿缺勤 " 的典型模式,如休假前后缺勤、周末和夜间缺勤过多和多天的休假,然后在必要时采取后续行动。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Results Absence rates for the six months prior to the incentive scheme ranged from 3.69 percent to 4.32 percent.
sentences.zh: 奖励办法之前六个月的无成果率从3.69%到4.32%不等。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: In the following six months they ranged between 2.87 percent and 3.96 percent.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的六个月里,这一比例介于2.87%至3.96%之间。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: This represents a 20 percent improvement.
sentences.zh: 这表明,这比以前提高了20%。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: However, analysing the absence rates on a year-to-year basis, the overall absence rate was 3.60 per cent in the first year and 3.43 per cent in the following year.
sentences.zh: 然而,在逐年分析缺勤率时,总体缺勤率第一年为3.60%,第二年为3.43%。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: This represents a 5 per cent decrease from the first to the second year of the study.
sentences.zh: 这表明,从研究的第一年到第二年,减少了5%。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: A significant decrease in absence over the two-year period could not be demonstrated.
sentences.zh: 无法证明两年期内缺勤人数显著减少。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Discussion The non-financial incentive scheme did appear to assist in controlling absenteeism in the short term.
sentences.zh: 讨论非金融奖励办法似乎有助于短期控制缺勤。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: As the scheme progressed it became harder to secure prizes and this contributed to the program’s losing momentum and finally ceasing.
sentences.zh: 计划进展后, 获得奖品就变得愈加困难, 导致计划失去势头,

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: There were mixed results across wards as well.
sentences.zh: 各病房的结果也好坏参半。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: For example, in wards with staff members who had long-term genuine illness, there was little chance of winning, and to some extent the staff on those wards were disempowered.
sentences.zh: 例如,在有长期真正患病的工作人员的病房中,几乎没有胜诉的机会,而且这些病房的工作人员在某种程度上丧失了权力。

sentences.en: Our experience would suggest that the long-term effects of incentive awards on absenteeism are questionable.
sentences.zh: 我们的经验表明,对缺勤给予奖励的长期影响值得怀疑。

sentences.en: Over the time of the study, staff were given a larger degree of control in their rosters.
sentences.zh: 在研究期间,工作人员在名册上得到了更大的控制。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: This led to significant improvements in communication between managers and staff.
sentences.zh: 这导致管理人员和工作人员之间的沟通有了重大改善。

sentences.en: A similar effect was found from the implementation of the third strategy.

sentences.en: Many of the nurses had not realised the impact their behaviour was having on the organisation and their colleagues but there were also staff members who felt that talking to them about their absenteeism was ‘picking’ on them and this usually had a negative effect on management-employee relationships.
sentences.zh: 许多护士没有意识到他们的行为对组织及其同事的影响,但也有一些工作人员认为,与他们谈论他们的缺勤是 " 挑拣 " 他们的,这通常对管理层与雇员的关系产生不利影响。

sentences.en: Conclusion Although there has been some decrease in absence rates, no single strategy or combination of strategies has had a significant impact on absenteeism per se.
sentences.zh: 虽然缺勤率有所降低,但没有任何一项战略或战略组合对缺勤本身产生重大影响。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Notwithstanding the disappointing results, it is our contention that the strategies were not in vain.
sentences.zh: 尽管结果令人失望,但我们认为,这些战略并非白费力气。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: A shared ownership of absenteeism and a collaborative approach to problem solving has facilitated improved cooperation and communication between management and staff.
sentences.zh: 共同拥有缺勤和采取协作办法解决问题,有助于改善管理层与工作人员之间的合作与沟通。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: It is our belief that this improvement alone, while not tangibly measurable, has increased the ability of management to manage the effects of absenteeism more effectively since this study.
sentences.zh: 我们认为,仅凭这一改进,虽然无法具体衡量,但自本研究报告以来,提高了管理层更有效地管理缺勤影响的能力。

items.prompt: The Prince William Hospital has been trying to reduce absenteeism amongst nurses for many years.
Nurses in the Prince William Hospital study believed that there were benefits in taking as little sick leave as possible.
Just over half the nurses in the 1986 study believed that management understood the effects that shift work had on them.
The Canadian study found that ‘illness in the family’ was a greater cause of absenteeism than ‘work to do at home’.
In relation to management attitude to absenteeism the study at the Prince William Hospital found similar results to the two 1989 studies.
The study at the Prince William Hospital aimed to find out the causes of absenteeism amongst 250 nurses.
The study at the Prince William Hospital involved changes in management practices.
